score_explanation: Your front and back poses show a clear silhouette and a stable stance. The back pose presents your width best. Tension in the hands and raised shoulders narrow the front presentation, especially when returning from the back pose. A quieter arm position and a deliberate shoulder setup would make the sequence more consistent.
biggest_opportunity: Create more lat width while keeping the shoulders and arms relaxed.
overall_strengths: A stable stance supports both front poses.

highest_priority_corrections.title: Relax your arms and hands
highest_priority_corrections.visible_evidence: Both front poses show excessive arm tension.
highest_priority_corrections.try_this: Keep a soft elbow bend and lightly cup the hands.

highest_priority_corrections.title: Set your shoulders before opening your lats
highest_priority_corrections.visible_evidence: The shoulders rise as you return to the front.
highest_priority_corrections.try_this: Set the shoulders down, then open the lats.

highest_priority_corrections.title: Lower the back-pose elbows slightly
highest_priority_corrections.visible_evidence: High elbows narrow the visible back silhouette.
highest_priority_corrections.try_this: Lower the elbows a little while keeping the torso tall.
